utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll need the start time and what tools to bring so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Pia — let’s do 9 a.m. on Saturday on the front porch, and please bring a basic screwdriver set and a small hammer if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, just let me know the time and I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — quick update: it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the time soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. Just let me know what time you can be there on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can be there at 10 on Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, 10 works for me. Please come to the front porch then, and I’ll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, 10 on the front porch Saturday. I’ll be there and ready to help with the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday on the front porch, so if you can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — I really appreciate it. If you can make it Saturday on the front porch, I’ll sort out a task for you when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, of course — I can greet folks at the porch and sort tools as they come in. Just point me to where you want me posted on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren. Quick update: the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll point you to the check-in table there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning works. What time should I tell everyone to be on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I can be there Saturday morning on the front porch for the repair drive. Just let me know the time, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday on the front porch, and I’d really appreciate any time you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I’m still in for Saturday on the front porch. Just let me know what you need me to do.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
